pr301_comment.body:
## Additional verified obstruction (no new CI run): authentic carries + entire conductor tower still do not select Weyl cancellation

**Result: PAPER-PROVED elementary construction; independent isolated exact-rational replay through N=128; not yet a committed executable module.** It strengthens the existing same-conductor counterfeit and isolates why *the exact four-pole recurrence itself*, beyond the carry and denominator clocks, is essential.

Let the genuine unwrapped zero-anchored sequence be \(U_0=0,\ U_n=16U_{n-1}+r(n)\), with fixed authentic four-pole \(r(n)\). Set
\[
Q_0=1,\qquad Q_n=\operatorname{lcm}_{1\le j\le n}\operatorname{den}(r(j)),
\qquad k_n=\lfloor U_n\rfloor.
\]
Define a **different**, explicitly labelled controlled state and its derived forcing:
\[
V_0=0,\qquad V_n=k_n+\frac1{Q_n}\quad(n\ge1),\qquad
r^*_n=V_n-16V_{n-1}.
\]

**(1) Exactly the same full integer-carry sequence.** Since \(Q_n\ge15\), \(\lfloor V_n\rfloor=k_n\). Thus for every n,
\[
c^*_n=\left\lfloor 16\{V_{n-1}\}+r_n^*\right\rfloor
=k_n-16k_{n-1}
=\left\lfloor16\{U_{n-1}\}+r(n)\right\rfloor=c_n.
\]
Both models have the same \(U_0=V_0=0\). This preserves each genuine **rational-state carry**, without falsely calling it an already certified pi digit.

**(2) Exactly the same monotone common conductor at *every* time.** For n=1, \(r_1^*=k_1+1/Q_1\) has denominator \(Q_1\). For n≥2,
\[
r_n^*=c_n+\frac{1-16(Q_n/Q_{n-1})}{Q_n}.
\]
Thus \(\operatorname{den}(r_n^*)\mid Q_n\). If a new prime-power layer enters \(Q_n/Q_{n-1}\), its prime p divides that quotient, while the displayed numerator is \(1\bmod p\), hence the new layer survives uncanceled in \(\operatorname{den}(r_n^*)\). Inductively
\[
\boxed{\operatorname{lcm}_{j\le n}\operatorname{den}(r_j^*)=Q_n}
\quad\text{for every n.}
\]

**(3) Its selected Weyl sums have *maximal*, not vanishing, normalized modulus.** Every odd prime p≥7 divides the reduced authentic forcing denominator at n=(p+1)/2: one pole factor equals p and the numerator reduces to \(3/2\pmod p\), nonzero. Hence \(Q_n\to\infty\) by Euclid. For every fixed nonzero integer h,
\[
e(hV_n)=e(h/Q_n)\longrightarrow1,\qquad
\left|\frac1N\sum_{n=1}^N e(hV_n)-1\right|
\le\frac{7|h|}{N}\sum_{n=1}^N\frac1{Q_n}\longrightarrow0.
\]
So the controlled sequence is non-equidistributed and satisfies \(|S_N^*(h)|/N\to1\).

**(4) Exact failed hypothesis:** \(r_n^*\ne r(n)\) (already at n=1); altered forcing can become negative (first observed at n=14). It does not satisfy the original four-pole positivity/moment law or the authenticated future Green identity with pi. This is not a counterexample to a theorem using the genuine global source.
